stimulus.body: Working set: 3283 lines under review for string length.

questions.stem: A lab report records 3283 lines while examining string length. What does string length refer to in this setting?
questions.explanation: string length: String length counts the number of characters, and an empty string has length zero. With 3283 lines in view, that principle distinguishes the correct choice; every other option rests on a specific misconception.
questions.hint: How long is an empty string?
